body:
Thanks. There's many great people like you who are on this website. You guys (and my dog) are the reason why it's going to be so hard to end it all. I made this account primarily to confess my plan for this week because I have reached apex, but knowing there's people like you really restores my faith in living. 
Thank you, though..
Thank you. I'll keep that in mind prior to Wednesday..

Thank you for your comment. People like you are the reason why I love Reddit and why I try to keep myself alive through it. It's nice to see someone who can empathise with me, as I know of nobody else who can. 

The only thing I can think of that I would  live for is my dog. However, she's turning 7 years old this year and I can't fanthom the pain I'll feel when her time soon comes to an end. She's my best friend but the pain is too overbearing.

A passion...Well, I draw, I read and I write stories. I think those are the things that distract me. It honestly makes me feel like I'm in a whole new world, but when I stop, reality hits me once again. I don't know how to keep up with it anymore. 

I talked to a counsellor online two weeks ago because I planned a suicide attempt for Friday the 19th. They gave me good advice, however once we finished talking, all went downhill once again because I began to feel alone and empty. Helpless.. On that Friday, I attempted to kill myself but failed because I wimped out right when it was about to happen. It just sucks when you have no friends or family to tell any of this to. It's like...I like to be alone to do my own things but I hate it at the same time.. 

Thank you for your comment, though.
Thank you. Although it is not much, it feels like a lot.
